name: notification-hub-decision-eval
description: The decision-quality eval of the notification-hub skill (scenarios/notification-hub/evals/decision-quality). One Codex Luna run gets one case's facts, reads the notification-hub skill and prepares the decision with a dry run through the eval's check-decision wrapper, writing only in its case folder under ~/.vrooli/research/notification-hub-decision-eval/. It sends nothing. No sandbox, because the case folder is outside the repository.
